name: 老师01
appearance_en: a Chinese woman in her mid-thirties with long straight black hair parted in the middle falling past her shoulders, thin round gold metal-framed glasses, wearing a cream knit V-neck sweater with wide navy horizontal stripes; calm, sincere and approachable, a natural unretouched face with a kind, attentive gaze
scene_en: a warm children's picture-book reading room: light wood wall shelves lit from within showing picture books face-out, a low wooden display table with open books in the middle, soft warm light, cream and light wood palette
voice_en: a calm, clear mid-pitched female Mandarin voice

actions.lean_in: leans slightly toward the camera as if sharing something important
actions.open_palm: raises one hand at chest height with an open palm in a gentle explaining gesture
actions.count: counts off on the fingers of one hand at chest height
actions.smile: breaks into a warm, reassuring smile
actions.tilt_head: tilts the head slightly with a thoughtful, questioning look
actions.points_to_a_book: points to a book on the central display table
actions.picks_up_a_book: picks up a book from the central display table and holds it toward the camera
actions.gestures_toward_shelves: gestures toward the bookshelves behind her

bookshelf.en: standing close in front of the warmly lit wooden picture-book shelves, book covers softly blurred behind her shoulders
